cases.disposition_reason: compare levels reached no color at 120 by 40, kept that band at 80 by 24, then returned to the truecolor band
cases.action_sequence: Turn Compare levels on, scroll the bands, narrow the terminal, then turn Compare levels off.
cases.expected_results: Colour bands for the supported levels are visible, and the page state is unchanged after return.
cases.forbidden_effects: Leaving Compare levels changes the selected page or an option value.

cases.disposition_reason: progress.label_width=10 truncates Push to registry and Build image and leaves the value column reserved
cases.combination_reason: Execute the default and one non-default boundary. Execute another option in combination only when needs declares a dependency. Unrelated options do not form a Cartesian product.
cases.action_sequence: Set progress.label_width from its default to another listed value through --opt or the Options control.
cases.expected_results: The visible Label column effect matches the selected value.

cases.action_sequence: Start, pause, resume, restart, and complete determinate, indeterminate, and aggregate progress.
cases.expected_results: The numeric value and the available actions match the phase.
